paper_metadata.title: Achieving excellent strength-ductility balance in the lightweight refractory high-entropy alloy by incorporating aluminum

evidence.quote: In this study, a Ti40Zr40Nb10Ta10 base alloy with enhanced ductility was chosen, and various amounts of Al were added to investigate the microstructure and mechanical behavior of these alloys.
A novel Ti40Zr40-xNb10Ta10Alx RHEA alloy with an excellent combination of strength and ductility was developed through the addition of Al.

the Al-0 alloy undergoes a BCC-to-BCT phase transformation, leading to an elongation of c = 0.429 nm. This process of phase transformation has been reported by Wu et al. in eutectic high-entropy alloys [54]. Therefore, the strain hardening in the Al-0 sample is attributed to the BCC-to-BCT phase transformation occurring during deformation, and the deformation mechanism involves twinning.
